# Sparx Maths

> Sparx Maths is a personalised homework platform for secondary school students (ages 11-16) backed by Cambridge research and evidence-based learning outcomes.

Sparx Maths provides AI-powered personalised homework and learning support for UK secondary schools, with proven impact on student engagement and grades. The platform is developed by Sparx Learning, a B Corp certified company, and has been validated through research partnerships with the University of Cambridge and RAND Europe.
